title: COLOR playground
gallery_text: An interactive study of color unfolds through experiments in perception, material origins, cultural trends, mixing, and collective preference. Moving between historical references and computational systems, the work invites visitors to observe, manipulate, and rediscover color as both a physical phenomenon and a shared visual language.

answers.interest: I am interested in working with simulations and digital twins. I want to experiment and see what comes out of it.
answers.suggestions: I am curious about procedural content generation. It’s not something I am exploring in my colloquium; I’ve simply observed it in Mini Motorways and wonder whether it could be useful.
